description: Foundational correctness release for deterministic full and incremental graph construction, real call and impact relationships, freshness and audit accuracy, structured JSDoc extraction and missing-documentation reporting, comprehensive tests, TypeScript 7 type-checking, canonical CLI/help/skill documentation, and verified local artifact installation.
deviation_notes: Canonical persistence now uses atomic deterministic full snapshots for both scan and update paths so normalized full/incremental state is equivalent. Dead legacy JSON scanner/ingest workers and their obsolete tests were removed; documentation audit uses one cached ts-morph Project per source path. Final verification ran 441 tests with 95.18% line coverage overall; the lower count versus baseline reflects retired legacy-ingest tests.
